  | none => none

      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with

  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>

  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued

  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder

  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>

  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

  match c with

  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

/-- `compInitialIndex` (Comptroller.sol): the value a market's reward index is set to when its
rewards are initialized. -/
def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- Accounts are numbered by their position in the account list. -/

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up
to date, and the speed in COMP per block. -/

  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/

  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat
  borrowerIndex : Nat
  accrued : Nat

/-- Comptroller state for the market: current block, both sides, the Comptroller's COMP, and

  blockNumber : Nat
  supplyState : Side

import CompRewards.Spec
namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>
      { a with borrowerIndex := borrowIndex, accrued := a.accrued + borrowerDelta })

def grantCompInternal (s : St) (user : Account) : St :=
  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then
    { s with reserve := s.reserve - amount,
             accts := s.accts.modify user fun a => { a with accrued := 0, wallet := a.wallet + amount } }
  else s

def claimComp (s : St) (holder : Account) : Option St := do
  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder
  return grantCompInternal s holder

def setSupplySpeed (s : St) (supplySpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with speed := supplySpeed } }
  else some s

def setBorrowSpeed (s : St) (borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

def setCompSpeedInternal (s : St) (supplySpeed borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => do
    let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
    distributeSupplierComp

    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=

    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then

  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with

    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>

    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }

  match c with

/-!
# COMP reward distribution specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the reward flywheel of Compound's Comptroller: the supply and
borrow reward indices of a market, the index recorded for each account, the COMP accrued to
each account, claims, and the one-time upgrade that Compound Proposal 62 ran on mainnet
(`_upgradeSplitCompRewards`, block 13322798, 2021-09-29). Candidates may not edit this file.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `comptroller : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`CompRewards/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`CompRewards.comptroller`.

Model, as a reader of `contracts/Comptroller.sol` would map it:

* One market. Its supply side and borrow side each have a reward index (`compSupplyState`,
  `compBorrowState`: `index` and `block`) and a speed in COMP per block (`compSupplySpeeds`,
  `compBorrowSpeeds`). Indices are mantissas at scale 1e36 (`doubleScale`).
* An account holds `supply` cTokens (`CToken.balanceOf`) and `borrow` borrow units (Compound's
  `borrowBalanceStored / borrowIndex`). The market's totals are the sums over all accounts.
* `supplierIndex` and `borrowerIndex` are `compSupplierIndex` and `compBorrowerIndex`; 0 means
  the Comptroller has no index recorded for the account. `accrued` is `compAccrued`, `wallet`
  is the COMP the account holds, and `reserve` is the COMP held by the Comptroller.
* Amounts are natural numbers in the smallest unit (1e-18 COMP); arithmetic is unbounded, so
  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

The implementation handles the Comptroller's calls: the policy hooks a cToken calls before it
changes a balance (`mintAllowed`, `redeemAllowed`, `transferAllowed`, `seizeAllowed` on the
supply side; `borrowAllowed`, `repayBorrowAllowed` on the borrow side), `claimComp` and
`_setCompSpeeds`. Balance changes, the passing of blocks and COMP sent to the Comptroller are
modelled here, outside the implementation.

namespace CompRewards

/-- `doubleScale` (ExponentialNoError.sol): the scale of reward index mantissas. -/
def doubleScale : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- `compInitialIndex` (Comptroller.sol): the value a market's reward index is set to when its
rewards are initialized. -/
def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- Accounts are numbered by their position in the account list. -/
abbrev Account := Nat

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up
to date, and the speed in COMP per block. -/
structure Side where
  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/
structure Acct where
  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat
  borrowerIndex : Nat
  accrued : Nat
  wallet : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An account with nothing: the record of any account number beyond the list. -/
def noAcct : Acct := ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Comptroller state for the market: current block, both sides, the Comptroller's COMP, and
the accounts. -/
structure St where
  blockNumber : Nat

namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>
      { a with borrowerIndex := borrowIndex, accrued := a.accrued + borrowerDelta })

def grantCompInternal (s : St) (user : Account) : St :=
  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then
    { s with reserve := s.reserve - amount,
             accts := s.accts.modify user fun a => { a with accrued := 0, wallet := a.wallet + amount } }
  else s

def claimComp (s : St) (holder : Account) : Option St := do
  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder
  return grantCompInternal s holder

  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>

  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

def setCompSpeedInternal (s : St) (supplySpeed borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => do
    let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
    distributeSupplierComp

  (s.accts.map (arch0_pendingAcct s)).sum +

import CompRewards.Spec
namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>
      { a with borrowerIndex := borrowIndex, accrued := a.accrued + borrowerDelta })

def grantCompInternal (s : St) (user : Account) : St :=
  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then
    { s with reserve := s.reserve - amount,
             accts := s.accts.modify user fun a => { a with accrued := 0, wallet := a.wallet + amount } }
  else s

def claimComp (s : St) (holder : Account) : Option St := do
  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder
  return grantCompInternal s holder

def setSupplySpeed (s : St) (supplySpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with speed := supplySpeed } }
  else some s

def setBorrowSpeed (s : St) (borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

def setCompSpeedInternal (s : St) (supplySpeed borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => do
    let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
    distributeSupplierComp

import CompRewards.Spec
namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>
      { a with borrowerIndex := borrowIndex, accrued := a.accrued + borrowerDelta })

def grantCompInternal (s : St) (user : Account) : St :=
  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then
    { s with reserve := s.reserve - amount,
             accts := s.accts.modify user fun a => { a with accrued := 0, wallet := a.wallet + amount } }
  else s

def claimComp (s : St) (holder : Account) : Option St := do
  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder
  return grantCompInternal s holder

def setSupplySpeed (s : St) (supplySpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with speed := supplySpeed } }
  else some s

def setBorrowSpeed (s : St) (borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

def setCompSpeedInternal (s : St) (supplySpeed borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => do
    let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
    distributeSupplierComp

namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>

  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then

  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder

  match c with

import CompRewards.Spec
namespace CompRewards

def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower).borrow deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct borrower fun a =>
      { a with borrowerIndex := borrowIndex, accrued := a.accrued + borrowerDelta })

def grantCompInternal (s : St) (user : Account) : St :=
  let amount := (s.acct user).accrued
  if amount > 0 ∧ amount ≤ s.reserve then
    { s with reserve := s.reserve - amount,
             accts := s.accts.modify user fun a => { a with accrued := 0, wallet := a.wallet + amount } }
  else s

def claimComp (s : St) (holder : Account) : Option St := do
  let s ← updateCompBorrowIndex s
  let s ← distributeBorrowerComp s holder
  let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
  let s ← distributeSupplierComp s holder
  return grantCompInternal s holder

def setSupplySpeed (s : St) (supplySpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.supplyState.speed ≠ supplySpeed then
    (updateCompSupplyIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with speed := supplySpeed } }
  else some s

def setBorrowSpeed (s : St) (borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  if s.borrowState.speed ≠ borrowSpeed then
    (updateCompBorrowIndex s).map fun s =>
      { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with speed := borrowSpeed } }
  else some s

def setCompSpeedInternal (s : St) (supplySpeed borrowSpeed : Nat) : Option St :=
  (setSupplySpeed s supplySpeed).bind fun s => setBorrowSpeed s borrowSpeed

def comptroller : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .supplyHook who => do
    let s ← updateCompSupplyIndex s
    distributeSupplierComp
